notes.title: Yurei Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Bright Flask.[/p][p][/p][p]To coincide with Steam Next Fest, the demo of [b]Yurei[/b], my top-down arena slasher, is now available![/p][p]You can now play the demo on Steam.
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651170/Yurei/"][/dynamiclink]If you enjoyed it, please don’t forget to add it to your wishlist![/p][p]Your support and interest mean a great deal.[/p][p][/p][p]I look forward to your continued support and excitement.[/p][p]Thank you![/p]
